translation.name: Yoac kekehagocac Dzadzahac gboria nga Mitiyegec

book.name: MATAIO
book.title: Mataio Yeng Yesuac Siduc Gombung Ohoec

content: Ama wereckenu womong gareng enara nga yudangic enarafocngina yeni uba mocgu amma Yesu homeudeac deserigec.
Deserima Yesu maria dedeckema Yudaia bangecac gawana Pirato, yearu mekemma yeac mariu faigec.

Anu Yesu homeudeac deserigec, Yuda benukererec ngicngo imoc hemma deec, “Ni nocac ifi andua?” Ifi dema ubea manganeu siriwa dzo 30 migec, imoc mekemma womong gareng enara nga yudangic enarafocngina yeni monggoc merengyemmema
edeyunuec, “Negenggec, ni kererema ngic kopocsiha kpac, ye sac nadzicmiai.”
Ifi deu yeneng degec, “Imoc neneac ebic kpac, imoc geac ebic.”
Yeni ifi dema dzo wagec, yeng imoc mekemma womonnu ukuu enu wama kemma ubasac neec.
Nga womong gareng enara yeneng siriwa dzo imoc kpedzucnema degec, “Dzo imocngo sac bummeec. Imocac amma dzo imoc sesekatapau faifai, imoc singngo mi dede.”
Dema yeni yoac dedzege amma dzo imocngo kuric yeneac kicsere fingerudeac enang kudzimemengic yeac ua bangec bummegec.
Bummegec bangec imocac kpara Sacbangec hanahema degec nga imoc yaguc fedengoc.

Profete Yeremiango yoac yofi deec, imoc imohai foragoc anec, “Faka yofi fingerudeac Kebungo edenuec, Israe medacfora yeni ngic imocac buma kpetea faima, “Ye siriwa dzo 30 imocacsoc.” ifi degec. Nga yeni dzo imoc mema imocngo enang kudzimemengic yeac ua bangec bummegec.’”
Anu yeni Yesu mekemma gawanaac kicfu faigec nammanu yeng kpesimiec, “Ge yudangic yeneac ngictau me?” Ifi deu Yesungo yofi meremmiec, “Imocnoc geanggaoc denec.”
Anu womong gareng enara nga yudangic enarafocngina yeneng namma haniaya degec Yesungo yoac turunga mong mi merengyemmeu
Piratongo kpesimiec, “Yeni yoacfu faiguma yoac homac yombong dedae, ge imoc mi negennec me?”
Deu yeng yoac monnec mong mi merenu gawanango kerectegec yombong anec.
Anu gawanango hombannu yofi angkefec, yuda ngichabu yeni witicngic monggac kpara kpacgec, yeng ngic imoc yungeru witicamaunac maande.
Naso imohai godzungic kpara kekena mong witicamau kefec, kpara Baraba.
Nga ngicngac kpedzucnedacma nammagec Piratongo yofi kpesiyemmeec, “Merac yungecngemmebadeac negendae, Baraba me Yesu, kpara mong Kristo deandae?”
Yudangic yeni Yesu eng keracmangang ammima yearu faigec, imoc negemmanoc ifi deec.
Nga Pirato ye desi desi tatahau tacmanu enemango yearu yoac yofi faiu kenec, “Ge ngic kpetiac yomocac yoac mi kpeserena, imoc wana. Ni tofocnac fema gaukpefing hemma yeac amma ubaebic homac medua.”
Nga womong gareng enara nga yudangic enarafocngina yeneng habu fenggeyemmegec yeneng Baraba yungecyemmeudeac degec nga Yesu ine kpehomegecdeac degec.
Nga gawanango kpesiyemmeec, “Ngic yohockang nandape yerearunac merac yungecngemmebadeac negendae?” ifi deu yeni imohaingoc degec, “Baraba.”
Ifi degec kpesiyemmeec, “Ifi anu Yesu, kpara mong Kristo deandae, yeac dafi ambade?” Kpesiyemmeu yeni sasawango degec, “Ye mariponnu kpena homeu.”
Ifi degec, yeng kpesiyemmeec, “Imoc dafiac nga noc kopocsicac?” Ifi deu yeni arohomumunggema degec, “Ye mariponnu kpebesonga.”

Ifi dema nanggec hemma Piratongo yoac dindingac deudeac obohoec. Nga yeni ine serima kpacma nanggec kpeborongtoa hanahema fingeru yeng doku mema ngicngac habutoa kicnginau namma maria dzuacma yofi deec, “Ngic yomocac sacac kopocsic, imocngo nearu mi tacbeso, imoc ngenearu febeso.”
Ifi deu ngicngac yeni sasawango yoara meremma degec, “Yeac sacac kopocsicngo neni nga nambaracfocnina nenearu febeso.”
Nga Pirato ye Baraba yungecyemmema Yesu ine dzikacngo kpema mariponnu kpegecdeac wasaingic maringinau wayemmeec.
Anu gawanaac wasaingicfora yeneng Yesu ama manaunac memama ama tegiau wasaingic oda manau kecandae, imohai meemma wasaiareng sasawa hafoangoc kpedzucnegec.
Kpedzucnedacma Yesu yengena wamba hesimima ngakpi mong kpauc kpauc heimigec kemeu
somang batihema oruhau heimigec kemeec. Kemeu yasu mong memigec marifoiango mema nanec. Ifi amma kiwau fafoc heima defagoc ammigec, “Ohec, yudangic yeneac ngictau.”
Amma yeni sofohoma yasu wangecma imocngo oruhau kpegec.
Defagoc ammikecgec wisickeu yenang ngakpi hesimima yengena wamba monggoc heimigec kemeu mariponnu kpegecdeac hesicke kenggec.
Mekemma sinnu ngic mong meficgegec, kpara Simong, Kirene taonnunac, yeng Yesuac maripong tofohoudeac ngombonggegec tofohou kenggec.
Kengkecma bangec buma mong kpara Gorigata, kpara mong Hatasic degec, ihai kensikegec.
Kensikema waing doku wiac hodungagocngo yerec yerecgea, imoc gumegec ye imoc nenegemma waec.
Nga yeni ye mariponnu kpegec nammanu wambaya kpeing kpema mederegec. (Mitiyegec 22:18)
Ifi amma garenga tacgec.
Nga ye nanu oruha witiau maripongau kopocsicac haniaya yofi ohogec, “Yomoc Yesu, yudangic yeneac ngictau.”
Anu yeni godzungic yohockang yegoc momoc mariponnu yuruma mong foiugeng nga mong kanaugeng, ifi faiyurugec.
Nga ngic ihai kengha anggec, yeni Yesu deengdema ammima orucngina kpatitickema
degec, “Ge Anutuac womong hembarackema wenac harebec ammanu medacbesonga denec, ge geangga onggongemena. Nga Anutuac medac kecnec isoc mariponnunac mesiemema mana.”
Nga womong gareng enara nga mitiac negen negengngic amma yudangic enarafocngina yeneng ifingoc desusuic ammigec,
“Ye ngic goa onggongyunukefec nga yengena ine naric mi onggongemeude. Ye israengic nenang ngictau kecdeu mariponnunac mesiemema mau ye negensinggenide.
Ye yofi dema negen negensinga Anutuaru faiec, ‘Ni Anutuac medac.’ ifi deu Anutungo yeac ammikecdeu mesibeso.”
Nga godzungic yegoc momoc yurugec, yeri yoac siriha ifiangoc deendema ammioc.
Anu wenac dzongiau 12 kiroc ammanu imohai ama kundung kpema kundungngo bangec sokoma fekemmanu 3 kiroc marai anec.
Nga 3 kiroc imohai Yesungo ubaudumeng kunengngoc kpacma yofi deec, “Eri, Eri rema sabaktani.” Imocac titiha yofi, Anutuna Anutuna, ge nocac wanudang? (Mitiyegec 22:1)
Anu ngic nanggec, yenearunac goango negemma degec, “Ye Eria kpacsambic ammide.”
Ifi kparu ngic mongngo negemma gereagoc nedzima kemma kondung sobing mong mema waingdoku aengagocfu nemuruckema kpinnu faima Yesu gumeec.
Nga goango ine degec, “Ngeni imoc wagec, Eria foracngoc hama meficgeu henni.”
Nga Yesungo monggoc ubaudumeng kunengngoc kparu asuya ereec.
Ereu homeec, imohaingoc Anutuac womonnu kpoructoa womongmana kpetiac yombong naguyau nanec, imocngo wihacnac botuhaungoc tohoma mama yohockang anec. Amma usoctoa meu fagannu hoctoa toa tohogec.
Nga kicsere fekenec, imoc anggeu ngic kpetiac warac homegec, yenearunac homacngo sebigoc gborigec.
Yesungo kicsereaunac gborima yaru yeni ngade kicserenginaunac erema taong kpetiac, imohai hama ngic homac fingecyemmegec.
Nga wasaigareng nga ngicfora Yesuac gareng nanggec, yeni usoc nga wiac fingerec, imoc hemma damuyunuu wareckema degec, “Foracngoc, ngic yomoc ye Anutuac medacnoc.”
Nga Yesu kpegec, imohai ngac homacngo araing namma wiac hennegeng anggec. Yeni Gariraia bangecfunac hanahema Yesu modacma hama kingang kpemigec,

yenearunac ngac goa kpacngina yofi, Maria kpara mong Madara amma Maria mong, Yakobo nga Yosefe, yereac nonggongira amma ngac mong Dzebedaioac medahora, yereac nonggongira, yeneng ngachabu yenigoc nanggec.
Anu Arimataia taonnunac ngic mong finactoayagoc, kpara Yosefe, yeng Yesuac yoac negemma yeac arennu ifingoc kefec. Ye ama toforebeso ammanu
Piratoaru kemma Yesuac fareng meudeac kpesimiec. Kpesimiu Piratongo migecdeac deu wamigec.
Wamigec Yosefengo Yesuac farenga mema linengkporuc mong kongaha, imoc mema imocngo tembonggema mekenec.
Mekemma yengena kicsere gboria dema hocsirau singa usu usuya feec, Yesuac fareng imohai faima hocyada mong kpedidinggeu kicsere naguya imocngo hedzickeu taru kenec.
Anu Maria Madara nga Maria ogea yereng kicsere naguya nonongkac ihaigeng fiec kenu taroc.
Wereckengau sabata asoac anu womong gareng enara nga farisaio yeni kpeturanggema Piratoaru kemma
degec, “Kunennina, ikocngic imocngo gbori kecmangoc, yoac mong deec, neni imoc negensidimbe, imoc edeguni negenna, ‘Ni homema wenac harebec ammanu Anutungo homecfunac megborinuu monggoc yacbade.’

Nga medacfora yeneng kemma farenga hamangec meworagec, ifi debauac, ‘Ye homecfunac yacdac.’ imocac ge kicsere garenggegecdeac edeyununa uameme harebec garenggebisia. Warac ikoc mong anec, imoc femanu ngadeac ikocngo witiau enu yadibacac imoc edegudimbe.”
Ifi degec Piratongo yofi edeyunuec, “Naric, wasaingic ngemmeba ngeni wangecyunu kemma kicsere garenggegecdeac kuc mekecdae, imocac sirihau garenggebisia.”
Ifi deu yeni kemma kicsereac hocnagu mi kpedidinggegecdeac witiau kpae faigec. Faima wasaingic yeneng gareng nanggecdeac edeyunugec.

Lineng imoc kpindzing mong ambiac ogea, imocngo wamba megec.
